subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should this remain the broad v2026.6.11 cross-channel incident tracker, or should maintainers split it under the narrower package-parity, WebChat, WhatsApp replay, and stuck-recovery trackers now?
rationale: The source evidence points to multiple partially fixed or still-open failure slices, so automation cannot safely decide the permanent tracking shape without maintainer incident-triage intent.

options.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until stable package parity and the remaining replay/stuck-recovery paths have one correlated proof story.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move the remaining WhatsApp replay, WebChat, package-parity, and stuck-recovery pieces under existing canonical items and close this only after each has an owner.

options.title: Close Under Package Parity
options.body: Close this under the beta-fixed package-parity issue only if maintainers decide that reply-session initialization fully explains the report.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until stable package parity and the remaining replay/stuck-recovery paths have one correlated proof story.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses release package state and current-main session/channel ownership where vincentkoc has the strongest recent evidence trail.
